premise: An injured survivor has to help evacuate someone less mobile than himself. The safest-looking floor becomes dangerous when it loses power.
cast: Patch: existing bandage identity; injured hand wrapped separately, white head/hands/feet, grounded orange bag.
Jo: adult orderly in blue-grey work vest, white round head/hands/feet, black stick limbs.
Len: adult maintenance worker/patient, mustard hospital blanket over grey clothes, right leg braced; white round head/hands/feet.
Infected hospital workers/patients: pale-green heads, hands and exposed feet.
locations: Emergency department -> staff corridor -> outpatient corner -> ground-floor maintenance store.
Main staff stairs -> third-floor south ward, nurses station, storeroom and roof service landing.
Far service stairs -> ground-floor imaging fire door -> receiving -> loading ramp.
Delivery hatch is on cafeteria side, separated from receiving escape path.
Bay office holds van key; ramp -> transport van -> yard gate -> checked bus depot office.
chronology: Day1: hand injury unrelated to infection; bay keys noticed; Jo and Len join.
Days2-6: relocation to store; chime tested and retrieved; transfer from ordinary chair to evacuation chair.
Days7-11: third-floor ward and ground-level escape mapped.
Days12-22: power/water access fail; main stairs unsafe; roof leak forces departure.
Day23: far-stair descent and imaging attempt fail; climb back shown.
Days24-29: battery chime plan, hatch scouted and route cleared.
Day30: far stairs, diversion, ramp/van/gate; depot shelter.
setups_and_payoffs: Len's maintenance knowledge becomes specific route/gate knowledge, not magical access.
Tested chime provides diversion; known keys/van provide actual exit.
Hand injury and Len's mobility constraint remain in final shelter.
persistent_states: Same injured hand throughout; injury not magically cured.
Ordinary chair left downstairs; evacuation chair used thereafter and folded into van.
Len keeps leg brace and cannot suddenly run.
Battery chime comes from maintenance store and works independently of main-power failure.
Chime is placed at cafeteria hatch, not in the receiving route characters need.
No single hand simultaneously carries the bag and pushes both chair handles; Jo/Len share tasks.
Van keys planted before rescue need and physically retrieved; no helicopter arrival.
visual_reference_status: Use existing preset main/drawing guide; prepare and inspect recurring side-character and new-location references before scenes.
